guidebook.intro: Village and farming. **X ni** after the action means “for X”: **Ma amvu ngu dede ni** (I dig for Grandma).

tips.title: Amvu ngu
body: **amvu** garden, **jau** hoe, **ofi** plant, **ofiyi** seeds, **kaka** maize, **ofunyo** groundnuts.

tips.title: … ni
body: **Ma ozo nyaka anzi ni** (I cook for the children), **Ma si e’yo sezu andre ni** (I write to Mother).
**Ma fe ii ti ni** (I give the cows water).

culture.title: Crops of West Nile
body: Cassava, sorghum, simsim, groundnuts and tobacco grow on the hills around Arua and Maracha.
